citation.authors: Juhl CR, Bergholdt HKM, Miller IM, Jemec GBE et al

cited_by.title: Does diet cause acne? Sugar, dairy and foods linked to spots

record.population: 78,529 children, adolescents and young adults aged 7 to 30 in 14 observational studies
record.design: Meta-analysis of dairy intake and acne
record.finding: Any dairy, milk, yogurt and cheese were each associated with higher odds of acne (for example any dairy OR 1.25, 95% CI 1.15 to 1.36). Adjusted results were smaller, there was publication bias and heterogeneity, and the authors say results should be read with caution.
record.note: Observational; some authors disclose pharmaceutical honoraria in the abstract record.
